answer: Trust enters only via 12 audited seeds, each with a vault of 1,000 credits refilling 25 per epoch, one grant per newcomer. Each grant bears a quill stamp from its seed, and every hop multiplies credit by 0.6, so three hops out an identity holds at most 216 credits while earning needs 400 — the trail dies at the ridge where vouches end. Forging 100 sybils needs 100 grants or bribing seeds whose 5,000-POA bond dwarfs the ~90 POA a fake earns per epoch. Edge case: a seed goes rogue and floods credits — quarterly audit freezes its vault and burns its bond, while 0.6 decay caps damage to one hop.
